cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your plate's back in the cupboard, ready for Sunday lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That one's got flowers. Ours were plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll take that one. The potatoes will cover the flowers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not hiding it under potatoes. I want six matching plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get five more before lunch. Keep the plain ones for spares; there's no need to count those today.

confusable: S04 confusion must be distinct from deliberate deception; D37 avoids revealing the replacement cause.
